title: Slushie Bar Salts Watermelon Cherry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Watermelon Cherry by Slushie Bar Salts is a delightful e-liquid that combines the refreshing taste of Watermelon with the sweet tang of Cherries. This Nic Salt blend is a perfect summer vape, capturing the essence of sun-ripened fruits in every draw. The e-liquid starts with the juicy, hydrating flavour of fresh Watermelon, creating a smooth and satisfyingly fruity base. This is then beautifully complemented by the bold, rich, sweet taste of Cherries, adding depth and complexity to the vape. The combination of Watermelon and Cherry creates a flavour profile that is both bold and refreshing, perfect for those hot summer days or whenever you crave a fruity escape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
